info.title: Ensemble Control Plane API
info.description: Control-plane contract for the Ensemble mobile command center (plan Part 3). Normative rules: (1) The ONLY security scheme is the control-plane session credential (short-lived access token, Part 6) — no endpoint accepts provider OAuth tokens or any client-asserted identity data. (2) Every resource (task, sandbox binding, gate, event stream, file/diff request, key record) carries an owner, and every request is authorized against resource ownership — access by identifier guessing is denied with 404. (3) The API is a read-only remote control over sandbox content: no write or exec endpoints exist; file and diff retrieval is confined to the task's SandboxBinding root, paths canonicalized, `..` and absolute paths rejected, and symlinks resolved to real targets via the sandbox provider's filesystem APIs BEFORE authorization (resolved targets outside the root are rejected). (4) Gate decisions are idempotent: the client-generated idempotency key is scoped to (authenticated owner, target gate); same-key/same-payload replay returns the original outcome, same-key/different-payload returns a typed mismatch, and a conflicting decision on a decided gate returns a typed conflict — never a second execution.

post.description: The client sends ONLY the authorization code and PKCE verifier; the control plane performs the code exchange with the provider server-side and validates the result per provider (OIDC: ID-token signature against published JWKS plus issuer/audience/expiry/nonce; GitHub: server-side user-API call). Identity is mapped by stable (provider, provider-subject-id) — never email. Provider tokens are used once and not retained. On the web target (x-ensemble-platform: web) refreshToken is omitted from the response body and delivered solely as an HttpOnly Set-Cookie.
post.x-ownership: none — this endpoint ESTABLISHES identity; it trusts no client-asserted identity data

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Refresh-token rotation with reuse detection: presenting an already-rotated refresh token revokes the whole token family (Part 6). Native clients present refreshToken in the body; the web target (x-ensemble-platform: web) omits it and the server reads the token from the HttpOnly cookie set by authExchange/authRefresh instead, rotating that cookie in the response.
post.x-ownership: the presented refresh token (body, or the HttpOnly cookie on web) identifies the session family; reuse revokes the family

post.summary: Sign out: revoke the session and its refresh-token family
post.description: On the web target (x-ensemble-platform: web) the response also clears the HttpOnly refresh cookie.
post.x-ownership: revokes only the authenticated caller's own session

get.x-ownership: returns only tasks owned by the authenticated user

post.summary: Create a task bound to a validated SandboxBinding
post.description: Task creation validates the binding (provider key present, sandbox reachable or creatable, root well-formed). Without a valid binding, creation fails with a typed error — there is no unbound execution path. The optional model selection (Part 9) is validated against the engine's provider catalog: an unqualified or unknown-provider id fails with the typed error modelSelectionInvalid; a valid selection is normalized (legacy aliases resolved) and drives the task's engine runs.
post.x-ownership: the created task and its binding are owned by the authenticated user

get.x-ownership: 404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user
404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user

get.summary: List the task's chat thread (including structured questions)
get.x-ownership: 404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user

post.summary: Post a chat turn or a structured-answer submission
post.description: Structured answers carry the answer-submission idempotency id from the Part 2 chat-transaction contract; replaying an identical submission is a no-op returning the original acknowledgement.
post.x-ownership: 404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user

get.x-ownership: 404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user
404 unless the gate's task is owned by the authenticated user

post.description: The idempotency key's uniqueness is scoped to (authenticated owner, target gate). The server stores a fingerprint (hash of the decision payload) alongside the key: replaying the same key with the same payload returns the original outcome (200); the same key with a DIFFERENT payload returns the typed mismatch gateDecisionPayloadMismatch (422); a conflicting decision for an already-decided gate returns the typed conflict gateAlreadyDecided (409) — never a second execution.
post.x-ownership: 404 unless the gate's task is owned by the authenticated user; the idempotency key is scoped to (owner, gate)

200.description: Decision accepted, or the stored original outcome for a same-key/same-payload replay

get.summary: Read-only directory listing inside the SandboxBinding root
get.description: The path is resolved strictly relative to the binding's allowed root with canonicalization; `..` and absolute paths are rejected with pathOutsideBindingRoot; symlinks are resolved to real targets via the provider's filesystem APIs BEFORE authorization and rejected with symlinkEscapesBindingRoot when the target escapes the root.
get.x-ownership: 404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user; retrieval confined to the task's binding root

get.summary: Read-only file content (server-tokenized spans for native rendering)
get.description: Same path-confinement rules as listFiles. Content is read-only; there is no corresponding write endpoint anywhere in this contract.
get.x-ownership: 404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user; retrieval confined to the task's binding root

200.description: File content with optional pre-tokenized highlight spans

get.summary: Read-only unified diff of proposed changes (gate review)
get.description: Same path-confinement rules as listFiles, applied to every path named in the diff.
get.x-ownership: 404 unless the task is owned by the authenticated user; retrieval confined to the task's binding root

parameters.name: gateId
parameters.description: Scope the diff to the changes a specific pending gate would apply.

get.description: Key records are write/rotate/delete only. Reads return masked metadata exclusively — no response schema anywhere in this contract carries stored key material back to a client.
get.x-ownership: returns only the authenticated user's own key records

put.summary: Write or rotate a sandbox/model-provider API key
put.description: Submitted over TLS, stored server-side under envelope encryption (Part 5 custody). Never persisted on-device, never logged, never readable back.
put.x-ownership: writes only to the authenticated user's own key record

delete.x-ownership: deletes only the authenticated user's own key record

get.summary: WebSocket upgrade for the notification event stream
get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket carrying the schemas in src/wsEventsV1.ts. The first client message MUST be `subscribe` with a current access token; the subscription is authorized at subscribe time, revalidated on reconnect and on token refresh/expiry via `refreshAuth`, and closed on an expired or revoked token.
get.x-ownership: events fan out only for resources owned by the authenticated subscriber

sessionToken.description: Short-lived control-plane access token issued by the Part 6 trust boundary (server-side PKCE exchange). The contract's ONLY security scheme; provider OAuth tokens are never accepted.

platformHeader.name: x-ensemble-platform
platformHeader.description: Transport hint only (never an identity assertion) for the Part 6 web refresh-cookie policy. When `web`, authExchange and authRefresh omit refreshToken from the response body and deliver it solely as an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie scoped to /v1/auth, and authRefresh reads the refresh token back from that cookie instead of the request body. Absent (the default, native behavior) leaves refreshToken travelling in the body only, with no cookie set.

keyKind.name: keyKind
keyKind.description: Which key record: a sandbox provider or a model provider.

relativePath.name: path
relativePath.description: Binding-root-relative POSIX path; `.` names the binding root itself (the browser's starting directory listing). Absolute paths and `..` segments are rejected (pathOutsideBindingRoot); provider-resolved symlink targets outside the root are rejected (symlinkEscapesBindingRoot).

BindingError.description: Typed SandboxBinding validation error (sandboxBindingMissing, sandboxBindingInvalid, sandboxProviderKeyMissing, sandboxUnreachable, workingDirectoryRootInvalid)

codeVerifier.description: PKCE verifier; the exchange itself happens server-side.

nonce.description: OIDC nonce echoed for ID-token validation (Google/Apple).

refreshToken.description: Required for native clients. Omitted by the web target (x-ensemble-platform: web), which relies on the HttpOnly refresh cookie sent automatically by the browser instead.

Rotates on every refresh; reuse revokes the family. Present for native clients; absent on the web target (x-ensemble-platform: web), where it is delivered ONLY as an HttpOnly cookie instead of this body field.

workingDirectoryRoot.description: Canonical absolute path; every file/diff path resolves strictly relative to it.

request.description: The task description / context-pack request text.

model.description: Optional provider-qualified model id ("<provider>:<model>", or "<provider>:default" for the provider's default) the engine's rounds for this task run with — the client surfaces it from the user's model settings (Part 9). Validated at creation against the engine provider catalog; an invalid selection fails with the typed error modelSelectionInvalid. Absent means the control plane's configured default chain.

progress.description: PersistedTaskProgressV1 per the Part 2 strict schema (ensembleProgressVersion: 1).

latestRound.description: The task's most recent round, when one exists. Lets GET /v1/tasks derive N/M progress for every task in one call instead of a per-task GET /v1/tasks/{taskId}/history fetch; the history endpoint remains the source for the full per-round list.

interactionId.description: Present when this turn is a structured-question interaction (kind: questions frame).

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated; unique per (authenticated owner, target gate). Retries MUST reuse the same key with an identical payload.

replayed.description: True when this response is the stored original outcome for a same-key/same-payload replay.

tokenSpans.description: Server-side highlight spans (shared token-span schema; native clients render these, web may Shiki-render locally — Part 10).

scope.description: Highlight scope shared between the server tokenizer and clients — the CLOSED vocabulary in src/tokenSpanV1.ts. Clients render an unrecognized scope as unstyled text.

key.description: The API key material. Write-only: no response or later read ever echoes it.

maskedHint.description: Last-4-style mask for display; never the key material.
